description: National Acquaculture Development Authority of Sri lanka - Live Fist Export Regulations
categorisation: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Fisheries under the National Aquaculture Development Authority Act. It establishes standards and compliance requirements for live fish exporters, including environmental regulations, facility requirements, health and safety protocols, and record-keeping obligations. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
